REFERENCE IMAGE: the attached approved whole-character sheet is the exact style, anatomy, clothing and identity reference. Draw COMPLETE FIGURES, never separated heads/bodies/limbs. Short powerful legs, broad adult torso, natural connected neck/shoulders, compact adult head, matching face/arm skin. Clean dark ink, painted volumes, practical leather and small brass details. Preserve the approved look.
IMPORTANT PRODUCTION PALETTE: paint ALL hair, beard and eyebrows a muted dusty PURPLE (#815e91, shadows also purple), never brown. This is a material separation pigment that the engine will recolor. All skin stays warm peach, clothes stay blue/teal, leather brown, metal brass/steel. Purple must be used ONLY for hair. No purple reflections on skin or clothing.
EXACT LAYOUT: FOUR columns and EIGHT rows = 32 complete sprites in a portrait 1024 by 2048 atlas, equal 256-pixel grid cells, generous transparent margins, same scale and floor baseline. Nothing clipped or touching another cell. TRUE transparent alpha, no ground shadows, no backdrop, no grid/labels.
Rows 1–5 are movement; all four frames within a walking row MUST hold the SAME camera facing:
1: empty-handed IDLE, front, right side, rear-right quarter, directly back.
2: FRONT walking, ALWAYS looking straight at viewer. Column 1 LEFT boot ahead planted; column 2 left planted under hips and RIGHT knee lifted; column 3 RIGHT boot ahead planted; column 4 right planted under hips and LEFT knee lifted. Swap the forward leg in the second half! Short steps, restrained lift, opposite arms counter-swing.
3: RIGHT SIDE walking, all faces in right profile. Four distinct contact/passing/opposite-contact/opposite-passing poses. Clearly show BOTH boots changing places. Short comfortable strides, NO high-kneed marching, no repeated standing pose.
4: REAR-RIGHT walking, all four views fixed rear-right, same distinct short contact/passing cycle.
5: BACK walking, all four directly away, same contact/passing cycle.
6: right-side PICKAXE four keys: low ready; overhead anticipation; low forceful contact to right at shin height with torso inclined; recovery. Both hands visibly wrapped around shaft.
7: right-side AXE four keys: low ready; over-shoulder anticipation; horizontal forceful contact to right at waist height; follow-through. Proper double-handed woodcutting grip.
8: right-side HAMMER four keys: ready; raised; downward anvil-height contact to right; recovery. Hammerhead, not handle, hits. Torso and knees participate.
No disembodied heads, no separately rotating parts, no floating tools. Entire same character painted together in every key.
Male identity: swept-back hair and compact short split beard with two small brass tips, strong brows and large nose. Keep shirt/braces/bracers/boots exactly as reference.
